title: fix(cli,spec): os plugin publish sends visibility only when asked; PackageSchema.visibility defaults to org
body:
Part of #20892
Clause-②: yes

This is the remaining code round of #20892 under ruling A of #20900 (the create-time default is `org`; maintainer 「同意」, ruling record 5921191703). The card stays open for its separate Tier H docs PR (ADR-0006 v4 open question 2), which is not part of this diff.

## What changed

**`os plugin publish` sends `visibility` only when `--visibility` is passed** — the shape `os package publish` landed in #20915.

- `packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/publish.ts`
  - The `--visibility` flag loses `default: 'private'`. An omitted flag is an omitted key in the `POST /api/v1/cloud/packages` body.
  - The summary gains a `Visibility` line: the control plane's answer (`pkg.visibility`), else the value this publish explicitly asked for, else `not reported by the control plane`. It never prints `undefined` and never reads a local default.
  - The "Re-run with --submit" hint reads that same value instead of the flag, so it also fires when a `marketplace` plugin is re-published without the flag.
  - The flag's help text says what omitting it does.
- `packages/cli/test/plugin-publish-visibility.test.ts`: the CLI pins (below).

**`PackageSchema.visibility` defaults to `org`** (was `private`).

- `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts`: `.default('private')` becomes `.default('org')`, with a doc comment naming the ruled default. `CreatePackageRequestSchema.visibility` stays `.optional()` with no default, unchanged.
- `packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts`: a `DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR[17]` row for `marketplace/Package:visibility` `"private"` to `"org"`. The spec build (`check:authorable-surface`) refuses an undeclared default move, and this row's `reason` is what every build prints when it accepts the flip.
- Regenerated, not hand-edited: `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/marketplace.json` (by the build) and `content/docs/references/marketplace/package.mdx` (`gen:docs`).
- `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package-visibility-default.test.ts`: the spec pins (below).

**Changesets:** `@objectstack/spec` minor (a published schema's default changes; carries `Clause-②: yes`), `@objectstack/cli` patch.

**Consumer seam, not changed here:** objectstack-ai/cloud `POST /api/v1/cloud/packages` (`packages/service-cloud/src/routes/package-publish.ts`). For an existing package it sets visibility whenever the body carries one; for a new package it applies an absent value as `org` (cloud ADR-0007 decision ②). Both facts are the `repo:cloud` seat's reading 5914751356 on #20892. The cloud repository is not readable from this session (contents API 403, `add_repo` refused), so the ruling's fork clause premise is **not re-read here**; nothing measured in this repository contradicts it.

**User-facing sentences:** the four sentences #20915 landed (the `os package publish` flag help, `cli.mdx`'s and `publish-and-preview.mdx`'s `--visibility` rows, and its changeset) say a new package gets `org` on ObjectStack Cloud when the flag is omitted. They stay true and are not touched. No hand-written page states the old `private` package default: the only other statement of it is ADR-0006 v4 open question 2, which belongs to the separate Tier H docs PR.

## Repro (before) and the same probe after

The real CLI source entry (`packages/cli/bin/run-dev.js plugin publish ARTIFACT --server http://127.0.0.1:PORT --token T`, through tsx) against a local capture server that applies the card's measured upsert semantics. The artifact is built with the CLI's own `createTarGz`.

| | upsert body captured | stored after |
|---|---|---|
| before (`5dbeb7d7b7`), re-publish of a stored `marketplace` plugin, no flag | `{"manifest_id":"com.acme.visprobe","display_name":"Vis Probe","visibility":"private"}` | `private` |
| before, create, no flag | same body | `private` |
| after (`5fbe80ef07`), re-publish, no flag | `{"manifest_id":"com.acme.visprobe","display_name":"Vis Probe"}` | `marketplace` (prints `Visibility: marketplace` and the --submit hint) |
| after, create, no flag | same body, no `visibility` | `org` (prints `Visibility: org`) |
| after, control: re-publish with `--visibility private` | `...,"visibility":"private"}` | `private` |

`PackageSchema.parse` of a row with no `visibility` (built `dist`): `"private"` before, `"org"` after. `CreatePackageRequestSchema.parse` of a request with no `visibility` carries no key, before and after.

## Pins

`packages/cli/test/plugin-publish-visibility.test.ts` (unit tier), with a stand-in route that models only the two route facts above; every pass/fail assertion is about what the CLI sent or printed:

1. The upsert body has no `visibility` key when the flag is absent.
2. The flag value is carried for each of `private` / `org` / `marketplace`.
3. Re-publishing a stored `marketplace` plugin without the flag leaves it `marketplace`; the summary prints `marketplace` and the --submit hint fires.
4. Control: the same re-publish with `--visibility private` moves it to `private`, so pin 3 is not vacuous.
5. Creating without the flag yields the route's default (`org`), and the summary prints it.
6. With neither the flag nor an answer, the summary says `not reported by the control plane`, never `undefined`.
7. `--submit` without the flag sends `submit_for_review: true` and no `visibility`.

`packages/spec/src/marketplace/package-visibility-default.test.ts`: an omitted `visibility` parses to `org`; each explicit value is kept; a value outside the three is still refused at `visibility`; `CreatePackageRequestSchema` leaves an omitted `visibility` absent and carries each explicit value.

Both files were run against the unfixed tree first: spec 1 red (`expected 'private' to be 'org'`), CLI 6 red.

## Verification (all at `5fbe80ef07`)

- **Ablation.** The fix was committed first. Each leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode (anchor hit x1 to x0, blob changed, trap-armed restore), inside a wrapper with its own EXIT/INT/TERM restore. Both subjects are imported by relative path from `src/`, so no `dist/` leg applies.
  - A, spec `.default('org')` back to `.default('private')`: 1 red (omitted parses to `org`), 8 green.
  - B, body always carries `flags.visibility ?? 'private'`: 4 red (pins 1, 3, 5, 7), 5 green (pin 2 x3, the control, pin 6).
  - C, summary reads `flags.visibility` only: 2 red (pins 3, 5), 7 green. The first attempt at C was refused by the tool before running anything (the replacement text already occurred twice in the file, so a landed mutation could not be proven); it was re-run with a unique replacement.
  - D, the hint reads `flags.visibility`: 1 red (pin 3), 8 green.
  - Every restore proven: blob equals HEAD (`9d71be7c8f35` spec, `f5a598c7ad6c` cli) and `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Tests.**
  - `@objectstack/spec`: `vitest run --project local` 589 files, 17248 passed (1 todo); `--project repo` 47 files, 832 passed.
  - `@objectstack/cli` unit tier (`vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`): 239 files passed and 2 failed at collection because `packages/cli` itself was not built (`published-subpath-console.pin`, `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`: "packages/cli is not built"). After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build` both re-ran green (2 files, 29 tests). The integration tier is declared to CI: this diff touches no integration-tier file and no spawn entry.
- **Typecheck.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0; `check:test-typecheck` ledgers unchanged (cli 3 files / 28 errors, spec 52 files / 246 errors). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` contains each new test file once, with 0 errors in any touched file.
- **Spec artifacts.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` then `check:generated`: 14 of 15 current, `check:docs` stale; `gen:docs` regenerated exactly the one reference row. The build prints the accepted default change with its reason.
- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`: 113 derived, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe. 110 exited 0 on the first pass. 3 exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `check:skill-examples` (no `client-react` build), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (packages without `dist/`) and `check:i18n-coverage` (the example and plugin build closure). After a workspace build (turbo, under the verify lock) all three re-ran with exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 113 derived, 113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0. The same derivation taken from a tree at `origin/main` `9b81314c29` with this diff applied (it applies cleanly) prints the identical 113 commands.
- **Lint.** `pnpm lint` (the full `eslint . --no-inline-config`) exit 0, no output.

## Acceptance notes

① The branch is behind `origin/main` (`9b81314c29` at the last fetch). None of the incoming commits touch a file in this diff, and the diff applies cleanly on that tip. `dispatch-gates` flagged some of its own inputs as changed upstream (`.github/workflows/lint.yml` and `ci.yml`, `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` among them). A derivation re-taken on that tip with this diff applied prints the same 113 commands, so the gate run above covers it.

② `packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts` is outside the claim's enumerated file surface. The build refuses the ruled default change without its row, so it is part of the ruled change.

③ No `semantic` migration entry: a package row is a control-plane record, neither authored metadata nor a stored `sys_metadata` row, so `os migrate meta` has nothing to rewrite. A row or request that writes `visibility` keeps it.

④ The `PackageVisibilitySchema` describe (`private = owner org only; org = all envs in owner org`) is left as is: the ruling assigns that follow-up to the `domain:spec` seat.
